title: 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' Cast Talks New Movie on SiriusXM
summary: The cast of 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' Ralph Fiennes, Joseph Zada, Mckenna Grace and Jesse Plemons spoke to Andy Cohen on SiriusXM.
body_markdown:
The cast of *The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping* are very special tributes.


Ralph Fiennes, Joseph Zada, Mckenna Grace, and Jesse Plemons joined Andy Cohen inside SiriusXM’s New York studio for a Front Row on[Radio Andy](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/radio-andy) , November 16, where they dished about their new movie, and the connection they formed after filming.


[Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Front Row Hosted by Andy Cohen Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTheHungerGamesSunriseOnTheReapingFrontRow)


McKenna and Joseph, who play Maysilee Donner and Haymitch Abernathy respectively, formed a bond so close, they put it in ink with matching ladybug tattoos.


“We got matching tattoos yesterday, actually,” Joseph revealed to Andy and the audience as he lifted up his pant leg to reveal the ink to the audience. “Our characters become family, after the ladybug sequence.”


“We’re washing each other’s blood off in the arena,” Mckenna added. “And then that’s when we become family.”


During the interview, Ralph learned in real time that Daniel Craig’s James Bond successor would be Robert Pattinson.


“I’m sorry. I’m in love with Daniel Craig still,” Ralph, who starred alongside Daniel in his 007 films, said. “So it’s a hard, it’s hard. He’s a great actor. I think he’d be, I’m sure he’d be great.”


For more from *The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping* Cast Front Row, click below.


Listen to the full *SiriusXM Front Row* special with the cast of *The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping* anytime on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTheHungerGamesSunriseOnTheReapingFrontRow) . *The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping* is out November 20.
